Petroleum Refinery Life Cycle Inventory Model (PRELIM) v1.6: model workbook (PRELIM_v1.6.xlsm) and User Guide and Technical Documentation (February 2022). Department of Chemical and Petroleum Engineering, University of Calgary. https://ucalgary.ca/energy-technology-assessment/open-source-models/prelim

Model workbook (.xlsm, read with openpyxl cached values) and its v1.6 documentation treated as one source. Locators: workbook sheet!cell (Constants, CokingRefineryCalcs, Main Input & Output); documentation PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 10). Four processes: (1) workbook Constants sheet defaults, which since v1.5/v1.6 are calibrated to proprietary industry data for the global-average region (Documentation App. A) and are NOT Gary et al. numbers except where a note says so; Min/Max columns loaded as value-min/max only where they bracket the value (reformer fuel and hydrocracker steam ranges do not and were omitted); atmospheric/vacuum furnace fuel, distillation steam and hydrocracker fuel/steam are calculated for the crude cached in the workbook (Abo_Solomon 2010) and say so; furnace gas in scf/bbl converted to MJ/bbl at the sheet own ratio (143 MJ = 145.739 scf). (2) Constants P160:T166 hydrocracker table by H2 make-up = Gary et al. 2007 Table 7.4 exactly (reprinted). (3) CokingRefineryCalcs utilities: amine (Gary), Claus (power and steam Gary; fuel and tail-gas power Parkash 2003), steam boiler (Parkash 2003 Table 10-8). (4) Documentation Table 4 (p.33), the original 2012 Gary-based defaults, identical to Abella and Bergerson 2012 SI Table S3: hydrotreater bands, reformer, FCC fuel, coker fuel and power, ADU/VDU power, isomerization power and SMR power are the same numbers as Gary et al. 2007 (marked reprinted, pool once against gary_2007_001); alkylation, distillation fuel/steam ranges, coker steam per bbl coker gas oil and SMR natural gas incl. feedstock are PRELIM own. Table 4 hydrocracker fuels (311 and 217 MJ/bbl), isomerization 211 lb steam and Claus -1215 are suspect misprints and went to other-values only. All PRELIM energy is LHV. Per bbl of process-unit feed unless stated. SMR in scf/scf H2 as printed (feedstock in _flows). Not loaded: lube unit, CHP catalogue (EPA 2015), Table 5 literature ranges (other sources), regional variants (only the global-average values are cached in the workbook; regional tables are not readable from cached values). Whole-refinery totals (cached deep-conversion run 547 MJ/bbl, 34.1 kg CO2e/bbl; Table 17 kg CO2/bbl for 12 Canadian crudes by configuration; Table 12 bitumen/dilbit) are in _other-values only.
